metadata.title: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
metadata.description:
Click to tweet and share this recipe: http://ctt.ec/uh7jP

Us Garos of Meghalaya not only love our pumpkin but love the pumpkin seeds too. 

We consume them by roasting on flat pan with salt. The are popular healthy anytime snack that is very easy and quick to prepare  and disappears from the platter really quick too. They taste good.
